title: Industrial theatre
content: I was somewhere that looked like here last night. I snuck in through the front exit there via some random hallways and stairs. The actual theater in my dreams had the seating areas a step up from the aisle, but I got tired going back and forth with chat gpt. it also was very wide with some of the "walls" extending into darkness. There was no movie playing, and I wanted to get out of there because I didn't want to be caught sneaking in without a ticket. So I looked towards the entry to walk out. The entry was far off and was lit up like an interior mall space store front. The store in the entery way was very bright in contrast to the dark theatre. It's was laboratory like... Children like beings were researching and conducting experiments, and they totally looked like they knew what they were doing. I was noticing that I myself, was a teenager again. I felt some resistance in trying to leave, but I was able to. Anyway, that store connected back to the mall. I was able to call it... "Oh this is gotta be a dream" and began looking around for a bit at all the details, food court, before I woke up. Does this theatre look or sound familiar?
